hypothesis: A minimal byte-exact deterministic framed-stream oracle can provide a falsifiable CM-DATA migration baseline before canonical Clay Bytes/Buffer ownership and VM-ingress semantics are selected.
counterhypothesis: A Python framing oracle can become an architectural dead end if its host-language copy/framing behavior is mistaken for canonical Clay value, ownership, effect, provenance, authority, or runtime semantics.

mechanism.ingress: bytes-like inputs are snapshotted to immutable bytes
mechanism.decode: strict exact-frame decode plus incremental fragmented/concatenated stream decode
mechanism.failure_policy: bad magic, oversize, checksum mismatch, truncation and trailing bytes fail closed
mechanism.crc32_authority: NONE; transport-corruption detection only, never authenticity/provenance/identity/capability/authorization/effect authority

covered_falsifiers: oversized advertised length fails before payload
readonly memoryview over mutable bytearray is snapshotted before later producer mutation

unusual_experiment.description: Embed the framing MAGIC itself plus NUL/0xff bytes inside the payload, then deliver the complete encoded frame one byte at a time and compare against single-shot decode.
unusual_experiment.interpretation: Self-similar binary content and maximal fragmentation did not confuse frame boundaries; streamed decode matched the baseline exactly.

ci_evidence.predecessor_limitation: Clay Machine VM bootstrap checked out exact predecessor head and passed its 9 existing VM regressions but did not execute tests/test_clay_data_plane.py.
ci_evidence.repair: candidate adds tests/test_clay_data_plane.py to Clay Machine VM bootstrap path filters, exact-head sha256 binding and execution steps

fusion: The current mutable-buffer provenance fence strengthens snapshot-at-ingress as the conservative reference behavior: readonly host access alone is not evidence that producer backing storage is immutable. Zero-copy remains deferred until explicit immutable provenance or lease/epoch ownership semantics exist. CRC32 is intentionally non-authoritative.
nonclaims: not a canonical Clay Bytes/Buffer type
not a canonical Clay ownership/lifetime contract
not wired through canonical typed/effect IR
not wired through the single ClayVM ingress path
no completed exact-final-head CM-DATA accepted-target gate yet
no CM-NET, CM-VIS or CM-AUDIO readiness claim
promotion_gate: Retain as TESTING until final-head CM-DATA CI completes and equivalent provenance-bound opaque-byte semantics are selected and wired through canonical Clay type/effect IR into the single VM, followed by accepted-target evidence.
next_falsifier: Observe the exact-final-head CM-DATA gate, then define the smallest canonical Clay Bytes/Buffer ownership+lifetime contract and prove one opaque-byte ingress through checker -> typed/effect IR -> single ClayVM with deterministic snapshot/borrow semantics and accepted Ubuntu evidence.
rollback: Close PR #693 and delete the candidate branch; product main and canonical workspace status remain unmodified by the candidate.
